overviewTitle: Giving teams control over prompts and AI operations
overviewDescription: Elacity Control Plane is an Ellavox AI product for managing prompts and AI agents across providers. It gives teams a way to version instructions, review changes and apply policies before publishing updates to their AI systems.

Operating these systems requires more than prompt editing. Teams need to see what agents are doing, receive useful alerts and respond when something changes. Approval processes, execution logs and provider integrations have to work together across the platform.

We developed notifications and automated action channels, integrated observability and guardrails, and implemented prompt policy checks and approval workflows. We also connected AI providers and added Stripe subscriptions and usage-based billing to support the commercial side of the product.

overviewTitle: Helping researchers explore new uses for existing medicines
overviewDescription: Every Cure uses AI to identify promising new uses for existing medicines. We helped build Orchard, a research platform where its teams can explore drug–disease relationships and review potential repurposing opportunities.

Researchers needed to narrow complex datasets, compare evidence and share exactly what they were looking at. Keeping filters, sorting and application state in sync was essential: refreshing a page or sending a link should not mean starting again.

We developed search and filtering tools that preserve research views in the URL, alongside sign-in, onboarding, administration and review workflows. We also refactored the frontend into reusable TypeScript components and added automated tests for key user journeys.

overviewTitle: Making clinical trial evidence easier to find and compare
overviewDescription: Confyde helps pharmaceutical and biotech teams work with clinical trial evidence. We helped build an AI-powered research workspace that lets users discover relevant studies, compare trial data and investigate questions about clinical development.

Research teams often have to work across separate sources to understand how studies differ and what their findings mean. The challenge was to bring complex information into a clear interface where users could search, inspect and compare the evidence.

The workspace combines retrieval-augmented generation with structured clinical data, interactive tables and visual summaries. Relevant source information supports AI-assisted analysis, while researchers can examine the data and interpret the findings themselves.
